notes.title: Hello...
notes.notes:
I apologize for the lack of updates for a while. Recently, I have been contemplating a lot about game development, and I would like to share some important news with you.

[b]Changes due to conflict with the artist:[/b] Unfortunately, due to conflicts with the existing artwork artist, collaboration has become difficult. As a result, I will be creating the game's art myself. This may lead to changes in the game's visual style, but I will do my best to implement it.

[b]Transition to Unity engine:[/b] I have decided to switch from the existing engine to the Unity engine. After the engine change, I plan to focus more on enhancing gameplay rather than the story.

[b]Artificial story issues:[/b] Reflecting on feedback that the existing story feels artificial, I have decided to create a new story from scratch. I will do my best to provide a more natural and engaging story that you can immerse yourself in.

[b]Adjustment of the development schedule:[/b] Due to the story reconstruction and engine change, the development schedule may be slightly delayed. I sincerely apologize for this.

notes.title: Crow Sound Effects Removed and Door Sound Effects Changed
notes.notes:
Hello,

To enhance the gameplay experience, based on player feedback, we have removed the crow sound effects and replaced the door sound effects with new ones. We appreciate the continued feedback from our players and will continue to do our best to provide a better gaming experience.

Thank you.

notes.title: New Minigame Added and Ongoing Language Purification in Korean Version
notes.notes:
Hello,

In this update, we have added a new minigame. After the conversation with the teacher in the staff room, you can enjoy a simple hide-and-seek game with Yuna. (Note: This content may not apply to existing save files.)

Additionally, we have removed some severe swear words from the Korean version of the game to reduce unpleasant experiences for players. This effort is ongoing, and we aim to remove all inappropriate language as quickly as possible to provide a cleaner and more pleasant gaming environment.

Thank you.

notes.title: New Minor Event Added in the Classroom
notes.notes:
Hello,

With this update, you can now experience a new minor event in the classroom by interacting with the blackboard and desks.

Note: This patch does not apply to existing save files. To experience the new event, please start a new game.

Thank you.

notes.title: New Loading Image and Dialogue Scene Improvement Update
notes.notes:
1. The image displayed on the loading screen has been updated to a new one.
2. In the initial school office scene, the grey-highlighted text has been removed and replaced with clearer and more effective staging.

notes.title: Game Release Delay Announcement
notes.notes: The game is currently complete, and we entered the build review process in mid-March. However, the review process is taking longer than anticipated, and we have not yet received approval, leaving our development team somewhat perplexed. We seek your understanding in this situation and plan to release the game immediately once the review is finalized. We ask for your patience and sincerely apologize for not being able to meet the scheduled release date. We would greatly appreciate it if you could wait a little longer.

notes.title: Early Access Launch Schedule Announcement
notes.notes: We'd like to thank everyone for your patience as we finalize testing and bug fixes on our game. We plan to launch in early access as soon as possible, aiming for late March or early April. Your support means a lot to us, and we're committed to delivering a high-quality gaming experience. Stay tuned for further updates.
